prompt:
Work from the styled table shown in the image: a zebra-striped table with one Name column, several numeric columns, alternating row shading, and a shaded header row. Use the source column to identify the winning row and transfer to the named target column. Determine the Age value from the row whose Cost value is largest.
Return a valid JSON object with keys "evidence" and "answer" in that order.
Evidence format: set "evidence" to an array containing exactly two bounding boxes [x1, y1, x2, y2] with the decisive source extremum cell first and the transferred target value cell second.
Answer requirement: set "answer" to the exact integer value from the transferred target cell.
Example JSON:
{"evidence":[[260,180,372,236],[374,180,486,236]],"answer":19}
